method: Exact Python integer predicates on a common power-of-two scaling of stored local float32 coordinates; sweep-and-prune exact bounding boxes, then all six segment-triangle tests including coplanar overlaps. Only contact lying entirely on indexed shared vertices or edges is accepted.
scope: Each stored local preview separately. Does not compare previews against each other or the unchanged global cortex. Does not certify continuous nonlinear images, GPU rounding or anatomical validity.
